name: Truffle Matron
description: Awakened truffle of Magic Might 30 who rules the Magic creatures that cultivate truffles throughout Mythic Europe, holding council in her regio and rewarding helpers with vis.

name: Truffle Regio
description: Three-level Creo-aligned Magic regio of the Truffle Matron, accessible only on solstices and equinoxes, containing the forest, truffle fields, and holt.

name: Truffle Fields
description: Second level of the truffle regio (Magic aura 5), where awakened truffles tend their crops among rings of awakened trees.

name: Truffle Holt
description: Third level of the truffle regio (Magic aura 7): two concentric circles of awakened trees on a low hill where the Truffle Matron holds court.

name: Truffle Council Chamber
description: Interior of the holt where roots form seats and a dais and the Truffle Matron hears the pleadings of her subjects.

name: Awakened Truffle
description: Truffles with Magic Might that guard truffles and trees in Magic forests; in the regio they come as workers, drones, daughters and the Matron.

name: Truffle Drone
description: Awakened truffle warriors and guards of Magic Might 15, usually mounted on Boars of Virtue; the lowest social stratum of the regio, who do not vote.

name: Truffle Worker
description: The weakest and most abundant awakened truffles (Magic Might 10), who tend the fields and burrow away from danger.

name: Truffle Daughter
description: Awakened truffles of Magic Might 20 who present issues to the Truffle Matron and can create Earth Elementals.

name: Wild Boar of the Woods
description: Giant Magic boar (Might 20) who guards the entrance level of the Truffle Matron's regio and protects its inhabitants.

name: Boar of Virtue
description: Lesser Magic boars ridden by truffle drones and kept in the truffle fields, possessing The Unimpeded Traveler power.

name: Interloping Wolves
description: Pack of Magic wolves (Might 13) that followed roe deer into the truffle regio intending to gorge on its magical creatures.

name: Awakened Tree
description: Mobile, living trees in the truffle regio that form the holt and serve as citizens of the Truffle Matron's council.

name: Earth Elemental
description: Elemental of earth (Might 20 Terram) created by truffle daughters or the Matron via Enliven the Gross Earth; this one was made from a small hill.

name: Truffle of Virtue
description: Unusually large vis-bearing truffle that can be Enriched by being eaten by a Magic creature; otherwise worth two pawns of Creo Herbam Dedicated vis.

name: Tree of Virtue
description: Vis-bearing trees (beech, hazel, oak, poplar) in the truffle regio; each contains two pawns of vis whose Art depends on the tree type.

name: Beech Tree of Virtue
description: Tree of Virtue with Vim vis in its beechnuts; its branches can be Enriched into an amulet granting the Luck Virtue.

name: Poplar Tree of Virtue
description: White poplar Tree of Virtue with Creo vis in its leaves; a crown of its leaves grants the Long-Winded Virtue.

name: Oak Tree of Virtue
description: Tree of Virtue containing Auram vis.

name: Hazel Tree of Virtue
description: Tree of Virtue containing Intellego vis.

name: Beech Amulet of Luck
description: Circular spider-web amulet woven from Enriched branches of a Beech Tree of Virtue; the wearer is treated as having the Luck Virtue.

name: Crown of Poplar Leaves
description: Enriched crown of Poplar Tree of Virtue leaves granting the Long-Winded Virtue to one wearer for about two weeks.

name: Creature of Virtue
description: Magic animals such as Ravens, Stags, Hares and Mice of Virtue that inhabit the truffle regio.

name: Wise Owl of the Forest
description: Creature that the Wild Boar of the Woods may have let into the regio, usable to help characters reach the second level.

name: Spell-like Creo Herbam Vis
description: Extraordinary vis in the form of a large truffle that, buried at a plant's roots, instantly heals it of injury, poison, or disease.

name: Lesser Enchantment Imaginem Vis
description: Truffle-shaped Imaginem vis whose shavings flavor food, giving a host +3 to influence guests.

name: Lesser Enchantment Rego Animal Vis
description: Truffle-shaped Rego vis whose scent compels wild boars and pigs to try to devour it, driving them berserk.

name: Spell-like Herbam Vis
description: Large truffle whose spores make plants in a six-mile area healthy and fruitful for a year and grow truffles on tree roots.

name: Black Truffle
description: Purplish-black truffle growing on oak and hazel roots in Normandy, Provence and Iberia, best in Périgord.

name: Burgundy Truffle
description: Dark brown truffle with hazelnut-like aroma found on oak and hazel roots across Mythic Europe.

name: White Truffle
description: Off-white truffle, best from Piedmont around Alba, growing throughout the Roman Tribunal and in Istria.

name: Bohemian Truffle
description: Above-ground truffle found in the Rhine, Greater Alps and Normandy Tribunals whose mature gel is a natural dye.

name: Desert Truffle
description: Above-ground truffle of arid Mediterranean lands, believed to be created where lightning strikes the sand.

name: Protect the Herd
description: Power of the Wild Boar of the Woods granting him and his animal allies +5 Soak for Sun duration.

name: Terror of the Charging Boar
description: Power of the Wild Boar of the Woods that overwhelms anything he charges with mortal fear.

name: The Unimpeded Traveler
description: Power of Boars of Virtue letting them run at full speed over any terrain.

name: Terrifying Howl of the Wolf
description: Power of the interloping wolves whose howl overcomes hearers with fear.

name: Traverse Mother Earth
description: Personal power of awakened truffles to burrow through the earth as fast as walking.

name: Truffle's Healing Touch
description: Ritual power of awakened truffles that instantly heals a plant of any injury, poison, or disease.

name: Enliven the Gross Earth
description: Ritual power used by truffle daughters and the Matron to create an Earth Elemental.

name: Control the Hungry Beast
description: Power of awakened truffles to mollify any beast so it no longer finds them interesting, threatening, or edible.

name: Banish the Unwelcome Guest
description: Truffle Matron's power to expel anyone from the regio by command, if it penetrates.

name: The Oath Swearing
description: Truffle Matron's power binding oath-takers so that breaking the oath inflicts a Minor Flaw.

name: Crush
description: Earth Elemental power to club and pin opponents, damaging their equipment.

name: The Red Touch
description: Earth Elemental power that rusts metal it touches or is struck by into dust.

name: Piercing the Magical Veil
description: Spell (ArM5 p.158) allowing characters to see into and pass between regio levels.

name: Converse with Plant and Tree
description: Spell allowing characters to talk with the awakened truffles and trees.

name: The Bountiful Feast
description: Creo Herbam spell usable to heal the Matron's damaged sapling and a model for the Spell-like Herbam Vis effect.

name: Lord of the Trees
description: Spell whose combat statistics match those of the awakened trees' branches.

name: She-Wolf
aliases: Aspect of the Daimon of Vengeance
description: Ancient Magic spirit, an Aspect of the Daimon of revenge, who dwells at the Wolf's Court and grants vengeance to petitioners by turning them into wolves.

name: Daimon of Vengeance
description: Daimon residing in the Magic Realm embodying revenge, of which the She-Wolf is an Aspect.

name: Wolf's Court
description: Ancient ruined shrine in a Magic aura 5 deep in the Majarida Mountains where the She-Wolf grants revenge.

name: Confession of the Penitent
description: She-Wolf power that imbues a target with the desire to confess a crime.

name: Donning the Corporeal Veil
description: She-Wolf power creating and animating a physical she-wolf body for the spirit.

name: Endow the Servant of Retribution
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Spiritual Pact Virtue on a target.

name: Gift of Silver Fur and Red Teeth
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Skinchanger Virtue, with wolf fur growing inward.

name: Inescapable Sense of the Quarry
description: She-Wolf power sensing the direction and distance of a target to which she has an Arcane Connection.

name: Scales of the Heart
description: She-Wolf power determining whether a petitioner believes his desire for vengeance is just.

name: The False Gift of Revenge
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Delusion Flaw so the target believes he becomes a wolf.

name: The Shape of Vengeance
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing the Lycanthropy Flaw, her usual means of granting revenge.

name: Virus Lunae
description: She-Wolf ritual power imposing Greater Malediction so the target spreads lycanthropy by scratches.

name: Voice of the Wolf
description: She-Wolf power producing an audible illusion of her voice within 15 paces.

name: Ritual of Passing on the Power
description: Rite by which the She-Wolf solemnizes a grant of power, taking the petitioner's birth name and giving a secret name of vengeance.

name: Luperci
description: College of Roman priests of Luperca who took wolf form to avenge unpunished sin; it survives as a Mystery Cult visiting the Wolf's Court.

name: Lupercalia
description: Two-day Roman festival from the Ides of February honoring the she-wolf, abolished by Pope Gelasius I.

name: Lykaia
description: Secret ancient rite on Mount Lykaion that turned men into wolves.

name: Interpretatio Romana
description: Roman practice of identifying native deities with Roman gods, which identified a Auvergne wolf goddess with Luperca.

name: Vultchi Praznitsi
description: Seven days in November in Bulgaria when sinners fear wolves; the last day, Koutzoulan, is the worst.

name: Werewolf
description: Men and women able to transform into wolves, known by many names across Mythic Europe.

name: Vukodlac
description: Variety of vampire from which half-wolf, half-man werewolf legends stem.

name: Erinyes
description: Three wolf-headed Greek sisters who were instruments of retribution for heinous crimes.

name: Airitech
description: Irish figure whose three wolf-daughters dwelt in the Cave of Cruachan; possibly herself a spirit of retribution.

name: Cas Corach
description: Faerie hero said to have killed the daughters of Airitech.

name: Gullveig
description: Northern giantess breeding wolves and witches in the Ironwood; patron of the Muspelli.

name: Muspelli
description: Northern witches whose patron is Gullveig.

name: Ishtar
description: Babylonian goddess of love and war who transformed unfaithful lovers into wolves.

name: Artemis Lykeie
description: Thracian wolfish form of Artemis, a faerie known for tearing the sacrilegious apart.

name: Pan Lykaios
description: Deity to whom the lykaia ritual meal on Mount Lykaion was sacred.

name: Wolf of Gubbio
description: Man-eating wolf that besieged Gubbio until tamed by Saint Francis of Assisi.

name: Saint Francis of Assisi
description: Saint who recently tamed the Wolf of Gubbio.

name: Elisha
description: Old Testament prophet whose 'Death in the Pot' story is thought to involve desert truffles.

name: Evander
description: Son of Mercury and Carmentis who founded Pallantium and brought the wolf-cult from Arcadia.

name: Carmentis
description: Cumaean Sybil, mother of Evander.

name: Mercury
description: God said to be father of Evander.

name: Romulus
description: Founder of Rome, suckled by a she-wolf, who slew his twin Remus.

name: Remus
description: Twin of Romulus, slain by him.

name: Marcus Antonius
description: Former chief priest of the luperci.

name: Pope Gelasius I
description: Pope who abolished the Lupercalia in the fifth century.

name: King Edgar
description: King legendarily said to have rid England of wolves in the 950s.

name: Plato
description: Records the lykaia rite on Mount Lykaion.

name: Bishop of Mende
description: Bishop who is also Count of Gévaudan, holding the Majaridas for the French crown.

name: Holy Vehm
description: Secret society known for kidnapping victims, midnight trials and summary justice.

name: House Mercere
description: Hermetic House with which vis sources are registered and whose members know the Order's personalities.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of Hermetic magi.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant whose library holds a copy of the Magic Lore tractatus on the truffle regio.

name: Cunfin
description: Covenant near Dijon in Burgundy.

name: Atramentum Renatus
description: Covenant near Dijon in Burgundy.

name: Nidi
description: Covenant near Périgord in the Normandy Tribunal.

name: Irencillia
description: Covenant near the Bohemian Forest in the Rhine Tribunal.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Tribunal where truffles are not found.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where truffles are not found.

name: Normandy Tribunal
description: Tribunal where black, white and Bohemian truffles grow; includes Burgundy and Périgord.

name: Provençal Tribunal
description: Tribunal with black truffles; the Wolf's Court is placed in its eastern reaches.

name: Iberian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where black truffles grow.

name: Rhine Tribunal
description: Tribunal with Bohemian truffles, the Bohemian Forest, and Ansbach.

name: Greater Alps Tribunal
description: Tribunal where Bohemian truffles grow.

name: Roman Tribunal
description: Tribunal where white truffles grow; includes Gubbio.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal within the range of Burgundy truffles.

name: Stonehenge Tribunal
description: Tribunal within the range of Burgundy truffles.

name: Theban Tribunal
description: Tribunal containing Mount Lykaion in Arcadia.

name: Transylvanian Tribunal
description: Tribunal including Istria/Old Histria and Bulgaria.

name: County of Périgord
description: Region of the Aquitaine producing the best black truffles; a suggested site for the truffle regio.

name: Piedmont
description: Region producing the best white truffles.

name: Alba
description: City in Piedmont famed for white truffles.

name: Istria
description: Croatian peninsula with the Motovun forest where white truffles grow.

name: Motovun Forest
description: Forest on Istria where white truffles grow.

name: Bohemia
description: Region of Germany where Bohemian truffles are eaten.

name: Bohemian Forest
description: Isolated forest in the Rhine Tribunal suggested for the truffle realm.

name: Burgundy
description: Region in Normandy Tribunal suggested for the truffle regio near Dijon.

name: Dijon
description: Town near a small forest suggested for the truffle regio.

name: Pazin
description: Place on the Istria Peninsula in the Kingdom of Croatia.

name: Kingdom of Croatia
description: Kingdom where truffles grow.

name: Dordogne River
description: River in Périgord.

name: Bergerac
description: Town near Périgord forests.

name: Le Cité
description: Town near Périgord forests.

name: Prague
description: Town near the Bohemian Forest.

name: Passau
description: Town near the Bohemian Forest.

name: Majarida Mountains
description: Densely wooded, nearly uninhabited mountains in south-central France where the Wolf's Court lies.

name: County of Gévaudan
description: County in the Auvergne long troubled by bold wolves.

name: Auvergne
description: Region of southern France where Romans found a wolf goddess shrine.

name: Pallantium
description: City founded by Evander on the site of Rome before Rome was built.

name: Rome
description: City where the cult of Luperca took root.

name: Mount Lykaion
description: Mountain in Arcadia where the lykaia rite took place.

name: Arcadia
description: Greek region containing Mount Lykaion.

name: Ansbach
description: Region in the Rhine Tribunal strongly associated with wolves.

name: Gubbio
description: City in Umbria terrorized by a man-eating wolf.

name: Umbria
description: Region of the Roman Tribunal containing Gubbio.

name: Bulgaria
description: Land in the Transylvanian Tribunal observing the vultchi praznitsi.

name: Cave of Cruachan
description: Irish cave on Bricriu's Glen where the wolf-daughters of Airitech dwelt.

name: Bricriu's Glen
description: Irish glen containing the Cave of Cruachan.

name: Ironwood
description: Mythical northern forest where Gullveig breeds wolves and witches.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Power where the Daimon of vengeance resides.

name: Divine
description: Realm whose aura from a growing town can trap a truffle daughter in a regio; protects foresters.

name: Faerie
description: Realm into which the She-Wolf could be varied as a faerie.

name: Infernal
description: The She-Wolf could be a demonic force tempting men to sin.

name: Regio
description: Magical area of layered levels accessible under special conditions.

name: Magic Aura
description: Area of Magic Realm influence; the truffle regio's levels have auras 3, 5 and 7.

name: Aligned Aura
description: Aura aligned to an Art; the truffle regio doubles its bonus for Creo activities.

name: Vis
description: Magical substance found in truffles, creatures and trees of the regio and sought by magi.

name: Extraordinary Vis
description: Rare vis in special forms such as spell-like or lesser enchantment truffles.

name: Dedicated Vis
description: Vis tied to a combination of Arts.

name: Enrichment
description: Process of enhancing a vis-bearing item, such as a Truffle of Virtue, into something with special properties.

name: Magic Might
description: Measure of a Magic creature's power.

name: Temporary Might
description: Flaw of truffles and elementals whereby spent Might recovers only over the season or with vis.

name: Acclimation
description: Process eroding Magic creatures away from Magic auras, to which the She-Wolf's Aspect is vulnerable.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Link such as blood or hair that boosts Penetration against a target.

name: Daimon
description: Kind of Magic spirit that projects Aspects into the mundane world.

name: Aspect
description: Part of a Daimon that interacts with the mundane world independently.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Initiatory cult; the luperci survive as one.

name: Parma Magica
description: Magi's magic resistance, which does not resist the wolves' bite attacks.

name: Ceremonial Casting
description: Casting method usable for a Ring/Circle Bountiful Feast.

name: Trained Group
description: Combat rule letting the wolf Pack Leader gain bonuses from his pack.

name: Essential Trait
description: Personality Trait that cannot be altered by magic.

name: Gauntlet
description: Rite ending apprenticeship.

name: Tribunal
description: Gathering of magi where disputes may be raised.

name: Familiar
description: Bonded animal companion of a magus, possibly knowing the truffle regio.

name: Spiritual Pact
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting access to a Magical spirit's Might pool and powers.

name: Skinchanger
description: Minor Virtue imposed by Gift of Silver Fur and Red Teeth.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue allowing sight into regiones.

name: Magic Sensitivity
description: Virtue usable to enter the truffle regio.

name: Luck
description: Virtue granted by the beech amulet.

name: Long-Winded
description: Virtue granted by the poplar crown.

name: Berserk
description: Virtue of the Wild Boar; porcine creatures denied the Rego vis become Berserk.

name: Enduring Constitution
description: Virtue reducing Fatigue penalties, possessed by the boars and wolves.

name: Magical Champion
description: Virtue of the Wild Boar of the Woods and She-Wolf.

name: Ways of the Wood
description: Virtue giving combat bonuses in woods.

name: Master of Animal Creatures
description: Virtue letting the She-Wolf train creatures with Animal-aligned Might.

name: Essential Virtue
description: Virtue of the Matron and daughters.

name: Lycanthropy
description: Major Flaw imposed by The Shape of Vengeance, transforming the victim into a wolf.

name: Delusion
description: Minor Flaw imposed by The False Gift of Revenge.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Major Flaw imposed by Virus Lunae.

name: Environmental Sensitivity
description: Flaw of awakened truffles, differing by truffle type.

name: Higher Purpose
description: Flaw of the Wild Boar (Protect the Wood), drones and daughters.

name: Wrathful
description: Flaw of the Wild Boar of the Woods.

name: Fury
description: Flaw of the Wild Boar of the Woods.

name: Anchored to the Earth
description: Flaw of awakened truffles.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability revealing knowledge about vis-bearing and awakened truffles.

name: Philosophiae
description: Ability granting knowledge of truffles.

name: Theology
description: Ability revealing the story of Elisha and the hadith on truffles.

name: Church Lore
description: Ability knowing clergy denounce truffles as witch's fare.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability revealing local truffle types and sites.

name: Organization Lore: Order of Hermes
description: Ability used to narrow authors of marginalia.

name: Code of Hermes
description: Ability possessed by the Truffle Matron.

name: Penetration
description: Ability adding to creature power Penetration.

name: Creo
description: Technique to which the truffle regio aura is aligned.

name: Herbam
description: Form of plants; truffle vis is often Herbam.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of one truffle vis source.

name: Rego
description: Technique of one truffle vis source.

name: Animal
description: Form of the boars' and She-Wolf's vis.

name: Mentem
description: Form of some creature powers.

name: Vim
description: Form of beech vis and several She-Wolf powers.

name: Auram
description: Form of vis in Oak Trees of Virtue.

name: Intellego
description: Technique of vis in Hazel Trees of Virtue.

name: Terram
description: Form of the Earth Elemental's Might.
